moats.claim: Configured workflow states, metadata templates and atomic permissions can embed business processes deeply enough to make migration costly; no exclusive network advantage is established.

productReasons.claim: State-based workflows with expiration, escalation and external actions model document approvals and reviews.
Non-destructive versions, page edits and redactions preserve original files and prior states for audit or rollback.
Template-generated metadata indexes and fine-grained role permissions organize large collections around business rules.

sponsorship.notes: No corporate sponsor named on official support/donation page reviewed; include verified service business Mayan EDMS LLC as steward fallback, not as an equity investor.
